edition.locus: On the Unity of the Church 23
edition.witness_note: Single locked witness in repo; second witness not yet locked.

source_text: Opto equidem, dilectissimi fratres, et consulo pariter et suadeo ut, si fieri potest, nemo de fratribus pereat et consentientis populi corpus unum gremio suo gaudens mater includat. Si tamen quosdam schismatum duces et dissensionis auctores, in caeca et obstinata dementia permanentes, non potuerit ad salutis viam consilium salubre revocare, caeteri tamen vel simplicitate capti, vel errore inducti, vel aliqua fallentis astutiae calliditate decepti, a fallaciae vos laqueis solvite, vagantes gressus ab erroribus liberate, iter rectum viae coelestis agnoscite. Contestantis Apostoli vox est: Praecipimus vobis, inquit, in nomine Domini nostri Jesu Christi ut recedatis ab omnibus fratribus ambulantibus inordinate et non secundum traditionem quam acceperunt a nobis. Et iterum dicit: Nemo vos decipiat inanibus verbis. Propterea enim venit ira Dei super filios contumaciae. Nolite ergo esse participes eorum. Recedendum est a delinquentibus, vel immo fugiendum, ne, dum quis male ambulantibus jungitur, et per itinera erroris et criminis graditur, a via veri itineris exerrans, pari crimine et ipse teneatur. Deus unus est, et Christus unus, et una Ecclesia ejus, et fides una, et plebs una in solidam corporis unitatem concordiae glutino copulata. Scindi unitas non potest, nec corpus unum discidio compaginis separari, divulsis laceratione visceribus, in frustra discerpi. Quidquid a matrice discesserit, seorsum vivere et spirare non poterit, substantiam salutis amittit.
pass_a_gloss: I wish, indeed, dearest brothers, and I advise equally and I persuade that, if it can be done, no one of the brothers may perish and the body of the consenting people, one, the mother, rejoicing, may enclose in her bosom. If, however, some leaders of schisms and authors of dissension, remaining in blind and obstinate madness, the wholesome counsel may not be able to recall to the way of salvation, the rest, nevertheless, either captured by simplicity, or led by error, or deceived by some cunning of deceiving astuteness, free yourselves from the snares of fallacy, liberate wandering steps from errors, recognize the straight path of the heavenly way. The voice of the contending Apostle is: We command you, he says, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, to withdraw from all brothers walking disorderly and not according to the tradition which they received from us. And again he says: Let no one deceive you with empty words. For therefore the wrath of God comes upon the sons of disobedience. Do not be, therefore, partakers of them. It must be withdrawn from those who offend, or rather fled from, lest, while someone is joined to those walking badly, and walks through the paths of error and crime, straying from the way of the true path, he may be held by equal crime. God is one, and Christ is one, and one is His Church, and one is the faith, and one is the people, bound into the solid unity of the body by the glue of concord. Unity cannot be torn, nor can the one body be separated by the separation of the joints, with the viscera torn by laceration, torn into pieces. Whatever has departed from the womb, cannot live and breathe separately, loses the substance of salvation.

pass_b_english: I want this, dearest brothers, and I both advise and urge it: if it is at all possible, may not a single brother perish, and may our mother, the Church, rejoice as she holds the whole consenting people in her bosom. Yet if certain leaders of schism and authors of dissension persist in blind, obstinate madness and sound counsel cannot bring them back to the way of salvation, the rest of you — whether taken in by simplicity, led astray by error, or tricked by some deceitful cunning — must free yourselves from the snares of fallacy, liberate your wandering steps from error, and recognize the straight path of the heavenly way. The Apostle's voice bears witness: "We command you in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ to withdraw from every brother who walks disorderly and not according to the tradition you received from us" (2 Thessalonians 3:6). And again he says: "Let no one deceive you with empty words, for because of these things the wrath of God comes upon the sons of disobedience" (Ephesians 5:6). Therefore do not become partners with them. We must withdraw from those who offend — indeed, we must flee from them — lest anyone who joins those walking badly, treading the paths of error and crime and straying from the way of the true path, be held guilty of the same crime. God is one, Christ is one, his Church is one, the faith is one, and the people are one, bound into the solid unity of the body by the glue of concord. Unity cannot be torn apart, nor can the one body be separated by the division of its joints, its viscera ripped by laceration and torn into pieces. Whatever has departed from the womb cannot live and breathe on its own; it loses the substance of salvation.

review.notes: The translation accurately captures the Latin text. Pass B correctly identifies and adds the required scripture citations (2 Thessalonians 3:6 and Ephesians 5:6) which were present as allusions in the Latin but not explicitly named. Pass A provides a faithful literal gloss. The title 'Preservation of Church Unity' correctly names the thought.
